claim_boundary: Read-only descriptive extraction. All recorded opportunities in the acquisition window are retained, including duplicates. Absence is not an empty detection, an occlusion finding, PASS or admission. Original terminal/checks/nulls remain unchanged. No ground truth, model, inference, target fit or predicted box is consumed. Image header ns and diagnostic acquisition_ns are exact recorded integers. Diagnostic stamp_s is also preserved with its recorded decimal precision; it supplies acquisition time only when acquisition_ns is absent, never a fabricated header. Bag payload hashes are not recomputed; original metadata, sensor-fault, closure and integrity small files are bound. PNG originals receive only lossless channel reordering; contact sheet thumbnails are review aids. This is first-loss diagnosis only; it cannot serve as the fixed short-shutter sensor4 attachment. Expected DROP and actual recorded input/output are separate. No original FAIL changes.

original_short_window_not_selection_basi.event_semantics: requested shutter pose interval, not an independently measured occluder state

shutter_execution.semantics: Matched SetEntityPose acknowledgements corroborate execution; request intervals are not exact rendered-image occlusion durations

contact_sheet.scope: Every exported raw RGB, same reader order; resized thumbnails and labels only, no boxes
